请分别选择已讲、当前和未讲三种状态的图片。: Choose an image for each state: past, current, and upcoming.
使用方法：\r\n1. 分别选择已讲、当前和未讲三种状态的 PNG 或 JPG:
1. Choose a PNG or JPG image for each state: past, current, and upcoming.
2. Select Use Custom Images.
3. Click Close.
4. Generate the indicators again.

Keep the image files accessible when generating again. Image paths are not saved with the presentation. Clearing the checkbox restores the previous shape, even if the list still shows Custom Images.

Choose small files with modest dimensions. PowerPoint copies several images to each slide, so large files can slow generation.

在 PowerPoint 中建立“节”后，插件会将节名称用作章节标题。操作说明：: Add sections in PowerPoint to use their names as section titles. Instructions:
“跳过”会给当前页添加标记，使它不显示进度条；“沿用”会复制上一张有效页的进度；: Skip omits the indicators on this slide. Repeat uses the preceding eligible slide's progress. Normal clears both tags. These actions keep the slide visible.
默认不为 PowerPoint 隐藏页生成进度图标，可在“排除”组中更改。: By default, hidden PowerPoint slides have no marker. You can change this in the Exclude group.
“排除”组可分别控制隐藏页以及“跳过/沿用”标记是否生效。: The Exclude group controls whether hidden slides and the Skip and Repeat tags affect progress.
开启“自动更新”后，更改设置会重新生成进度条。“预览”会先移除指定范围内的旧进度: Auto Update regenerates indicators when settings change. Preview removes indicators in the selected range and regenerates only a few slides. After a preview, or after adding, deleting, or reordering slides, click Generate to update the full range.
